en: I know the feeling. I enjoy shopping while I'm doing it, and then when I get back home, I calm back down and realize what I've done.
Yeah, exactly! And it ain't like y'can just go return it.
That's not good. If you develop wasteful spending habits when you're young, you'll never be able to save up money.
Ain't that the truth. And I can't just keep moochin' off my folks forever, neither.
That isn't so bad. If there's something you want, you should buy it.
Yeah, but sometimes I'll buy clothes and then end up never wearin' them, not even once.
Not even once? Yeah, that is pretty wasteful.
See, I told ya! I feel wicked guilty about this sorta thing.
Lately, on my days off, I try to make it a point to stay at home. That way I don't wind up doin' any shopping.
Good idea. You should go shopping only when there's something you really need to buy.
I guess. But then, like, what if I wind up getting' all stressed out?
How about trying some sports? It doesn't cost anything, plus it's good for your health.
Hmm. I used t'really like swimming, but now I'd hafta get myself a new swimsuit. And there's a membership fee for the pool, too.
Well, so that isn't necessarily free, but it'd still be cheaper than going shopping, right?
Yeah. And it has been a while! Maybe I'll give it a shot! Y'wanna come with me, Kiryu-san?
Swimming pools and I... don't mix. I'm more of an ocean kind of guy.
You don't need to get stressed out. Just don't let the day-to-day stuff get to you, and you won't run off to do some impulse shopping.
Easier said than done! I gotta deal with loads of stress every day in this job!
Hey, should you be saying this to a client?
Right. Sorry. But see!? I get stressed out just makin' sure I say the right stuff!
That's it! I'm gonna buy somethin' on my way home today!
You shouldn't do that.
If you stay at home, you can just shop online.
Oh, hey, that's true!
It's much easier to buy things that way than it is going to a store, so the temptation may be even worse.
Whoa, that's a wicked good point. I might use my credit card to splurge on stuff with no thought 'bout my account balance.
Thanks for pointin' that out! I guess I should get outta the house after all.
Try to control your spending, that's all.
I could buy things for you. Then there'd be no problem.
I mean, so long as it's not too expensive. Don't ask me to buy you a car or anything.
Hmm. But like, it's fun t'go shopping. It's nice to get presents and all, but it doesn't scratch the same itch, ya know?
I wish I could just go shoppin' without having t'spend money.
You're a real piece of work.
Ah, I'm just feelin' kinda gutted, is all.
Are you going to call it a day?
Ahaha! No, it ain't that bad, silly! You're so funny, Kiryu-san.
Uh, I am?
I know I shouldn't let myself be like this, but I dunno what I oughta do.
Do something sooner rather than later. If you ignore what's wrong, it'll just keep getting worse.
I don't mind.
That's easy for you t'say!
What's the issue?
There's a new guy on staff who don't bother t'close the door when he's messin' around in the can, and it's got me in a real mighty tizzy!
That's gross.
Ain't it jus'!? 'Course I'm gonna get myself all up in a twist! Ya can't do that sorta thing!
Your accent really comes out when you're angry.
'Course it does! I'm gettin' all steamed up jus' thinkin' 'bout it!
Wait, what does "gutted" mean, exactly?
Don't let it get to you. That sort of thing isn't worth worrying yourself sick over.
Huh? I ain't exactly feelin' sick.
No, I just mean, you said you're feeling gutted, right? Are you feeling nauseous or anything like that?
Kiryu-san, don't tell me you're trying t'give me advice when ya don't even understand what I'm sayin'.
Quit on embarrassin' me! If ya don't understand Hakata dialect, then jus' go on n' say so!
A can of what?
Huh? Oh, no, sorry! I got all flustered and slipped back into my accent, there.
There's someone on staff who keeps leavin' the door to the restroom open. And I think that's really gross, so I'm really annoyed over it.
Oh, I see. So "gutted" means annoyed.
What? Y'didn't understand what I was sayin'?
Christmas is comin' up this month, y'know? So I'm all jazzed 'bout coming in to the club every day t'make some cash!
Is there something you want to save up to get?
Weeell, I'd like t'open my own business.
That sounds nice. Let me know when you're up and running.
Y'really mean it!? You betcha, Kiryu-san!
Yeah, seriously. I've wanted to have my own business ever since I was a little kid.
A cabaret club?
Nah, bein' a hostess is just a part-time thing. I'm not planning on doing this sorta thing forever.
I'd really like t'have my own Western-style eatery.
A Western-style eatery? Like a restaurant?
Yeah. I'd probably just trick out my place and run things outta there.
Sounds fancy. I bet it'll be the talk of the neighborhood.
Hope so! It'd be extra great if it could just be a cozy sorta thing I run with my future husband.
You're looking to get married?
Sure! It'd be way simpler to run a business when ya've got two folks working together.
Good point. I'm sure that'll be fun for you.
So that's why I'm savin' up the cash now! Hope I can make it happen while I'm still in my twenties!
Well, I'm rooting for you.
That might be rough.
You'd be together all the time, with no breaks. Even an argument over something trivial might cause your whole life together to fall apart.
I guess that's true. But in that case, I just gotta try to be real friendly and not get into arguments with him, y'know?
I suppose that'd be for the best.
Do you have a partner?
Hey! Don't go askin' me something like that! A partner's gonna come later.
Saving money is all well and good, but you can't ignore other important aspects like that.
A business like that reflects the tastes of locals by definition.
I'd be concerned your business idea might not work in this day and age.
It's fine. I'm not tryin' to get rich or nothing. I just think it'd be fun to try.
I see. Well, I hope it goes well for you.
Kiryu-san, do y'ever get stressed out?
I'm pretty stressed right now. That's why I come to places like this to unwind.
Yeah, makes sense. In that case, just relax and let me take care of ya reeeal good.
No, I don't. I'm a pretty simple guy.
For real? So then you're naturally relaxed all the time?
Why, are you stressed out?
Yeeeah.
Have you not been out shopping lately?
That's more of a hobby. Something I go do because I wanna have fun. It doesn't really help me get rid of any stress, y'know?
Well, how do you get rid of stress?
Hmm. Going for a drive does the trick.
Cars are good for that. The highways around here form loops, so they're well-suited to just taking a spin and letting loose.
Yeah, exactly! Do you drive a lot, Kiryu-san?
Well, it's my job. But I have to stay pretty alert, so that gets tiring.
Oh, that's right. It's a shame you can't use your car to relax.
I don't have a car. I haven't lived here for very long, after all. Though I am starting to wish I did have one.
Well, if y'buy one, we can go out driving together! Maybe we can see who's fastest!
Hey, that's not really a drive. That's more of a race, isn't it?
Want me to take you for a spin? I know some nice driving routes.
I prefer drivin' myself. I'm not a big fan of being in the passenger seat.
You have your own car, then?
Yep! I used to drive my folks' car, but I kinda dinged it up a bit, and so they got all mad and told me to buy my own.
What kind did you buy?
Just a little one. It's cute.
What's the make and model?
Uh, I dunno, I don't care 'bout that sorta thing. I'm not into cars so much as I am just driving them, y'know?
That does sound like you.
Make sure you're careful. Cars are convenient, but just one mistake while driving can lead to big problems.
Yeah, yeah, I know all that stuff. I mean, it's fine so long as I don't do nothin' to cause an accident, right?
That's the sort of attitude that causes accidents in the first place. You shouldn't drive without following proper driving etiquette.
Sheesh, enough with the lecture already, Kiryu-san. Let me go on drives my own way.
No, I'm fine. I was just thinking about how proper and poised you are. You come across like a seasoned pro.
Oh, no, not at all! I had a major screw-up today.
Yeah. I was fixin' a customer's drink, and while I was doing that he got out a cigarette.
So what happened?
I went to go light it for him, and I wound up knockin' the whole bottle over.
You must be clumsy.
I'm fine when it comes to handlin' stuff one thing at a time. It's when I gotta do a buncha stuff at once that I get all flustered.
That's kind of cute. Little things like that give a girl more charm than if she was perfect in every way.
I mean, guys might think that, sure. But to the other girls I just come off like a big nuisance. They're always chewin' me out afterwards.
Ah, is that how that sort of thing goes down? Women can be really complicated.
You need to relax more. There's no need to get all worked up over it. Just calm down and do things slowly and carefully.
I wish all of my customers were like you, Kiryu-san. Sometimes guys get mad at me if I'm too slow for 'em.
Guess you'll have to get used to things.
Don't worry about it. Everyone makes mistakes like that sometimes.
I'm not exactly worried about it. It's just that they told me the cost of the wasted bottle was gonna be taken outta my paycheck.
Ouch. That's rough.
And I recently got a customer's cigarette ash into his drink by accident, but he didn't notice it at all.
One of the other girls spotted it for me, but if he drank it like that, it woulda been wicked bad for me.
I bet it would have, yeah.
I wish I could just handle myself better when a buncha stuff's happening all at once!
You can do it. I know you can.
I have an eye for this sort of thing. Trust me.
Hehe. Havin' someone like you tell me that makes me really believe it! Thanks, Kiryu-san! I'll do my best!
That depends on you. It takes more than just wanting to change. You need to put the effort into making that change happen.
But I thought I was already doin' that. And it's not having any real effect.
Well, that's no good. Hmm...
Don't panic. That's what causes these slip-ups.
Yeah, I guess. But in that case, what do y'think I oughta do?
Well, you should establish a list of priorities. Cigarette first, drink second, and so on. Then you can handle things more easily.
But I already do that! But then I'll be pourin' a drink, and a guy'll get a cigarette out, so I gotta go and light it, and so on and so on...
You seem fine around me. I don't think you're really prone to slipping up all that much.
Yeah? I guess y'have a point. But I'm not really nervous right now.
You can do it. Just do things like you normally would, and it'll be fine.
Yeah, but like, that's because I'm here with you, Kiryu-san.
What makes me so special?
Well, I just... Never mind that! I just wanna be able to keep myself from getting nervous 'round my other customers!
You aren't nervous around me?
Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean t'get all relaxed like this around you. Sorry 'bout all this, Kiryu-san.
No, it's fine. I'm not mad or anything. Don't worry about it.
Sooo, Kiryu-san. I'm putting together a new dish for ya!
Oh, really? What are you making?
Nuh-uh, that's a secret!
Can I at least get a hint?
A hint? Hmm. Okay! Is it a Japanese dish? Yes or no?
Nope! It's a Western dish! I told ya how I wanted to open a Western restaurant, right?
Oh, that's right.
Yep! 'Cause my dream is to open a Western-style restaurant. Good memory, Kiryu-san!
Naturally.
That's not a hint. You're giving me a quiz.
Details, details! So, which is it?
Okay, question number two! Is it a hot dish? Yes or no? C'mon, guess!
Correct! Since it's cold this time of year, I gotta cook up somethin' nice and warm!
This is sounding really good already.
Nooope! It's wicked cold this time of year, so I'm not gonna make you somethin' cold!

Okay, on to question number three! Hmm, let's see.
Kiryu-san, do you got anything?
Well, I can't think of nothing else! C'mon, Kiryu-san! Gimme a question!
Fine, fine.
Is it seafood?
Oh, good one!
Well, is it?
Hmmm. Nope!
Ah.
What's the first letter?
What? Hey, that's cheating! You'd be able to guess it way too easy!
